# README banner and icon

`banner.jpg` is the picture at the top of the README. It was generated locally with Z-Image Turbo (bf16) in ComfyUI through `bw.py gen --raw --graph zimage_turbo`: 1536x640, 9 steps, cfg 1.0, sampler res_multistep, scheduler simple, seed 2026, batch of 4, the third picture. It was then resized to 1280x533 and saved as JPEG.
